login.heroTitle: A calm operating home for Janzu practitioners worldwide.
login.heroBody: Manage clients, sessions, certification progress, locations, events, and community workflows from one secure portal.
login.title: Sign in with magic link
login.description: Enter your email and we will send a secure sign-in link.
login.success: Check your email for the sign-in link.
login.genericError: We could not send the magic link. Try again.
login.invalidLink: That sign-in link is invalid or expired.

dashboard.title: Dashboard foundation ready
dashboard.description: Authentication is wired first. Role-specific dashboards will be introduced after RBAC is implemented.
dashboard.pendingDescription: Your account is active, but no portal role has been assigned yet.

admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.description: Manage users, approvals, certification decisions, and platform operations.

manager.title: Manager dashboard
manager.description: Coordinate operational reviews, events, approved locations, and practitioner support.

facilitator.title: Facilitator dashboard
facilitator.description: Support sessions, practitioner guidance, and facilitation workflows.

practitioner.title: Practitioner dashboard
practitioner.description: Manage your profile, private clients, sessions, feedback, and certification progress.

form.title: Practitioner profile
form.description: Manage the information that can appear on your public practitioner profile.
form.invalid: Check the profile fields and try again.

public.title: Find Janzu practitioners
public.description: Explore public practitioner profiles by location, language, and practice focus.

clients.title: Client CRM
clients.formDescription: Create a private client record for your own practice.
clients.listDescription: Only you and authorized admins can access these records.
clients.name: Name
clients.invalid: Check the client fields and try again.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.formDescription: Record a Janzu session for your private practice history.
sessions.listDescription: Feedback validation will be connected in the next sprint.
sessions.invalid: Check the session fields and try again.

feedback.title: Session feedback
feedback.description: Your feedback helps validate this Janzu session.
feedback.invalid: Check the feedback fields and try again.
feedback.alreadySubmitted: Feedback was already submitted for this session.

certification.title: Certification
certification.description: Certification requires 50 validated sessions and final admin or manager approval.
certification.approvalDescription: Review eligible practitioners and approve final certification after 50 validated sessions.
certification.emptyQueue: No eligible practitioners are waiting for certification approval.
certification.approvalInvalid: Certification approval could not be processed.
certification.approvalForbidden: Admin or manager access is required to approve certification.

locations.title: Locations
locations.formDescription: Share a pool, spa, or natural water location for community review.
locations.listDescription: Locations become public after admin or manager approval.
locations.reviewDescription: Review submitted water locations before they appear publicly.
locations.publicDescription: Browse approved pools, spas, and natural water locations shared by the Janzu community.
locations.name: Name
locations.invalid: Check the location fields and try again.
locations.emptyReview: No locations are waiting for review.
locations.emptyPublic: No approved locations are public yet.
locations.reviewInvalid: Location review could not be processed.
locations.reviewForbidden: Admin or manager access is required to review locations.
